title: A gate about a size cap states each option's measured result
goal: When /kb-backlog records a gate whose options change a capped file (AGENTS.md 4096 bytes, README.md), each option states the file's size after it, measured, so the operator is not asked twice as with TK-ziyv2537's agents-cap gate in SP-v5xagbyv, whose recommended fold was still 101 bytes over
